prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1095; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. If your insured has already provided a statement or been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you disclose the full liability and bodily injury policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm in writing that you will preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair and total-loss records, dispatch and call logs, and any video or telematics information in your possession or under your control.

Our client's medical treatment is ongoing, and we will forward documentation of injuries, treatment, and related expenses as it becomes available. We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the requested information.
